name: command-palette
title: Command Palette
useCases: In an editor, a user types part of a command name and runs the matching action with Enter.
In an admin console, an operator finds the command for opening the ticket queue. The app maps the selected command to its route.
task: Find and execute an action from a known list of commands.
behavior: Pass action names in commands. onExecute receives the selected name on confirmation. The dialog filters the list locally.
